meta.design: Design 4 (queen bed, vanity + 3 m bracket wardrobe on the east wall)
meta.units: mm, plan coordinates (same as floor_plan.json: +x right, +y down the page)
meta.layout: Per owner's sketch IMG_1380 (2026-10-28): queen bed in the north-west corner, headboard on the west wall; study table along the full west wall below it (1 chair, monitor on the wall); east wall from the window: vanity 400 D, then a 3 m bracket-and-pole wardrobe (no carpentry) with pull-out mesh baskets behind free-sliding bi-fold doors. Full-length mirror on the south wall; bag hooks in the lobby (swapped). No TV.
meta.orientation: North = facade/window wall (top of plan). East = facade side wall (right). South = Bath/WC 1 wall with the WC door at x 11950-12650. West = Bedroom 2 wall; lobby + room door to the south-west.
meta.note: Product sizes are typical catalogue sizes; confirm before ordering.
meta.inspiration: Owner's reference videos: white slotted wall standards + brackets, wire shelf on top, poles hung under it, double hang with a lower shelf, stack of pull-out mesh baskets on runners.

interior.note: Wall-face to wall-face, assuming 150 mm internal / 200 mm external walls: ~3125 W x 4250 L. Verify on site.

bed.note: Headboard on the west wall, long side along the window. Footprint 1990 x 1530 incl. an 80 mm headboard (frame assumed mattress-sized).

vanity.note: Vanity 400 D x 1250 long at the window end of the east wall (window wall to the wardrobe), floating top, open below for the stool. Daylight from the window.

bracket_wardrobe.note: Not carpentry: 3000 long on the east wall, ~600 deep. Wall standards + brackets, wire shelf at 2050 (boxes on top), upper pole at 1900 full length. North 1000: double hang (shirts over a wire shelf at 1150 + lower pole at 1000 for trousers). Middle 650: 4 pull-out mesh baskets on runners fixed to the standards (each slides out 350; slider per basket in the HDB Reno tab) under a mesh shelf, short hang above. South 1350: long hang.

bifold.note: White free-sliding bi-fold doors, 4 pairs (~372 leaves) on one top track 625 from the wall. Each pair folds and slides to either end (-1 = vanity / north end, 0 = closed, +1 = south end). Park them at the SOUTH end: parked at the north end they stick out ~370 right next to the foot of the bed.

l_desk.note: Study table 1700 x 600, the full west wall from the bed to the lobby; end panels, no cabinets below. 1 office chair.

monitor.note: PRISM+ X340 PRO on a VESA wall arm on the west wall above the study table, facing east. Bottom edge ~150 above the desk.

hook_rail.note: Bag hooks on the lobby's south wall (swapped with the mirror). Starts at x 11300 and bags hang east of ~11350 so the room door's swing clears them.

mirrors.name: Full-length mirror
mirrors.note: Room's south wall (swapped with the bag hooks), between the WC door and the wardrobe; clear of the folded bi-fold stack (~14030).

mbr_gap.note: foot of the bed / vanity / wardrobe end

mbr_mirror.note: full-length mirror on the south wall
